meta.revised: Publication version: source claims, filename matches, access uncertainty and text-level duplicate evidence are separated.
meta.purpose: Dated comparison of the original 144 repository files against the school/edition listings on two public casebook directories.
permitted_inputs: Private dated retrieval and extraction evidence; not included in this public repository.

local_corpus.note: No corpus file was added, removed, or modified by this audit; duplicate candidates are flagged only.

method: Every school-edition named on the two primary pages is enumerated exactly as the page labels it (StrategyCase: 47 ranked + 4 new 2025-26 editions + Indian B-school books with FMS exploded into the 5 editions the page names; MasterTheCase: all 76 school-year entries).
Matching is by explicit normalization only (exact filename / season-year / school+year with named variant); no fuzzy title matching was used.

present_title_match = a local file matches school+edition by the stated normalization. Content identity vs the aggregator copies was NOT verified (no downloads); page/char counts are correlational only and prove neither equivalence nor distinctness.
uncertain = a plausible near-year candidate exists but season boundaries cannot be confirmed from filenames.

source_reported_gate = absent locally; the source page or a captured secondary source explicitly reports a possible login requirement or an access restriction (e.g., StrategyCase: hosts 'may ask you to log in before downloading'; Soreno: Kellogg 2016 cover states KCC members only). Direct access was NOT tested by this audit; no host is asserted to require payment or login.
access_unverified = absent locally; hosted on a third-party site, with no gate statement in the captures for the entry and no access test performed by this audit.
primary_source_available = absent locally but a school/firm primary host for it is seen in the research captures.

duplicate determination is exclusively SHA256 over normalized extracted text (Unicode NFC, whitespace collapsed). All 144 local case files were grouped corpus-wide: 134 distinct hashes, exactly 10 multi-file groups (canonical list: text-duplicate-candidates.json, recomputation-verified). Every group falls within the flagged same-label candidate pairs; no cross-label text-identical groups exist. text_identical establishes text-level equivalence only - it cannot certify graphics, scans, layout or pagination; text_differs establishes that equivalence was not proven - it does not prove distinct editions or cases. Candidates are flagged only; every file is preserved.
distinct_school_edition_keys_across_both_pages counts normalized school+year LISTING keys on the two pages; it is a listing count, not an assertion about distinct physical books.
Claims made BY the sources (page counts, case counts, tier verdicts, '700+ cases') are recorded as claims and are not treated as verified facts.
verification_flags: MasterTheCase capture contains no direct file URLs: every download link is the #two-step anchor, so per-edition source URLs cannot be cited beyond the page itself.
Initial MIT Sloan 2011 text extraction was image-only; later OCR was performed. See the source catalogue for current case-index coverage.
Kellogg_Case_Book_2012.pdf: Poppler syntax errors during extraction (text still extracted).

Text comparisons use pre-existing pdftotext output; extraction-order artifacts can make scans of equivalent books hash differently, so 'text_differs' means 'not proven equivalent', never 'proven distinct'.
Duke Fuqua Casebook-2012.pptx / -2013.pptx / Michigan Ross Casebook-1999.doc / NYU Stern Casebook-2000.doc are office docs outside pdf-inventory.json and outside both source pages' enumerations.
meta.snapshot_scope: Comparison against the original 144 local files, before publisher-linked additions. A listing match is not a content identity check.
